title: Trust in God's Perfect Plan Even in the Midst of Pain
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful testimony of faith and perseverance, highlighting the importance of trusting in God's plan even when life gets difficult. In this sermon, Pastor Chris opens up about his recent health struggles, including back surgery and a torn rotator cuff, and shows how he chose to maintain a spirit of faith and gratitude despite the challenges. Hear how his experiences can inspire you to stand firm in your faith and trust in God's goodness, even in the midst of uncertainty.
